primary: Hold out all rows in one of 14 independent metapopulations, estimate incremental log loss for ring distance-1 and distance-2 prior-positive neighbors beyond a reference including contemporaneous prior prey density in focal patch and whole metapopulation mean, other prior source counts, zero streak, day, treatment, block, nearest source ring distance
secondary: Does adding prior own + metapop prey density help the fixed v1.226 reference? Report direction regardless of outcome, never replace primary
predictor_timing: Each feature at observed visit t; target at t+1 only. No future prey or density used.
assay_stop_rules: nonfinite, missing or negative count/volume, inconsistent dilution flags, source row/header/MD5 drift: STOP without imputation
model: reuse fixed v1.226 sklearn scaler + L2 logistic(C=1,liblinear), training other 13 metapops, 14 LOSO folds. Fixed 2,000 cluster bootstrap descriptive only
